result:
Round 481 is planned and handed to A. The decision is **CONTINUE**.

**Round 480 (RETRO) accepted.** C passed all 13 rows with 0 bugs, including the browser checks at both viewports. The gate was skipped because no source changed, so the baseline for round 481 stays at `bbb3193`. The task is archived as `tasks/round-480.md`, byte-identical to the original. Nothing else moved to "done" (მზადაა); the design-fix items still wait for root's design-gate re-run.

**Why round 481 isn't the regression.** I planned at 2026-11-12T23:14Z and the last regression was 2026-11-10. That is 2 days, and the rule needs 3, so the regression is not due yet. The previous plan had assumed this planning would fall on 11-13. The new order is:
- **481:** the dead "Browse Music" link (fix below).
- **482:** the regression round.
- **483:** the screen-reader page-title fix (GATE479-M1).
- **484:** the new order-card bug below.
- **Then:** the button clean-up and the rest of the design fixes.

**Round 481: the "Browse Music" button on an empty My Orders page leads to the 404 page.**
- **Change:** in `app/routes/account.orders.tsx` only, the button's target goes from `/music` to `/store`. Its text, look and page are unchanged.
- **Kept as a plain link:** it still reloads the whole page. A client-side link would skip announcing the new page title to screen-reader users, the same gap as GATE479-M1.
- **Reproduced in the browser:** I used a fake signed-in session in Playwright. On the current code the button lands on the 404 page at both viewports. On my draft of the change it lands on the Store page, and the first Tab goes to the header logo.
- **Tests:**
  - Two new tests, AO1 and AO2. Both fail if the target goes back to `/music`.
  - If the link is switched to a client-side link, the test fails only by crashing, not on an assertion, so the test title doesn't claim to check that.
  - tech-lead reviewed and approved the draft, and its notes are applied.
- **For C:** browser checks at both viewports, using the fake session. They cover where the button lands, that the page fully reloads, the first Tab stop, and the button's styles against values I saved from the current code. They also confirm the signed-out "Sign in required" page and that `/studio-lab` still opens without signing in.

**The bug stays partly open.** The same dead link is in `account.downloads.tsx`, which is protected, so I filed ROOT-REQ-DOWNLOADS-MUSIC-LINK for root or Saba.

**New findings:**
- **B-R480-ORDER-CARD-KEYBOARD (Medium):** an order card on the same page opens only with a mouse click, so keyboard and screen-reader users can't see an order's items or prices. This comes from reading the code and a lint warning; I haven't reproduced it in a browser yet. It's scheduled for round 484.
- **B-R480-SITEMAP-COLLECTIONS-MUSIC (Low):** the sitemap lists `/collections/music`, which is a 404. Deferred.
- **SIG-R480-E2E-STALE-MUSIC-NAV:** an end-to-end test still expects a "Music" nav link and silently skips that step. Recorded as a signal only.

The advisor was available and I consulted it twice, after orientation and as a closing check; its fixes are in the task. No architecture checkpoint was needed, and the store tree is clean.
